note: Frozen before scoring. ELV TC Sreda (jobs/elv-tc-vpm): AGR booklet PDF (vector) + Revit 2023 FBX. GT = facade title convention (left axis -> right axis seen from outside) mapped to the model frame by the roof ray-cast footprint: axes 1..12 run west->east along +X (axis 12 = east wall with the rounded entrance recess, p23 plan fragment), axes A..I run north->south (I = south: p20 section B-B and p24 plan fragment put axis I on the 1-12 facade). az = outward normal azimuth, 0 = +X east, 90 = +Y north. Titles, axis bubbles, dimension chains and level marks are outside the boxes; axis-label positions are used ONLY for the drawing scale (pt per m), never for the face.
rays_change: only change to upstream rays.py: also skip mesh objects whose world max z > 30 m (one stray Revit batten at z 166 m, x 96 m; building top 16.4 m). Frozen before scoring.
segment_filter: PDF drawing items (lines, rect edges, curve/quad chords) fully inside the box; keep only segments within 2 deg of horizontal or vertical and longer than 0.05 m (drops glass hatch, rhomb callouts, letter curves).
